extension.disclaimer: The author of this add-on does not host any content and has no affiliation with the content providers
extension.news: 2026-08-23 * Whitelist Add/Remove no longer reports an update if nothing was changed * Save Debrid and Meta Account Data list updated * Authorise Debrid and Meta Accounts added to Account Manager (installed add-ons only) * Authorise accounts are listed debrid A–Z, then meta A–Z; headings are hidden when there is only one group * Enable Skin Override Protection hidden again; Disable is only shown if protection is already on * Account Manager Lite is only shown when it is installed * Refined binary add-on handling so Kodi can update them without deleting the add-on folder * Build installs now keep the zip's add-on database; full table wipe is only used on Fresh Start * Clear Packages on Startup can be Disabled, Every startup, 10 packages or 20 packages * Fresh Start progress dialog now closes before files are deleted * Video cache device presets use adaptive read factor (Kodi 21 and 22) * Whitelist Add-Ons moved to the Tools menu; Add/Remove lists show the add-on name only, including disabled add-ons * Force Update Add-ons now also scans local add-ons, not only repositories * Optional Kodi name, full version, release date and OS on the main menu (default on) * Build Menu only shows the build count when it is greater than zero * Build install shows a finalising notification after extraction * Video Cache Settings only shown on Kodi 21 and 22 * New-build notification ignores list reordering and no longer shows a blank name * Upload Kodi Log added; View Logs kept as a fallback, with a plain dark scrollable window * ResolveURL OffCloud and TorBox open the ResolveURL settings page to add an account * Build rename map prompts even when the version number is unchanged
